Primary RULE0556..0567/EXTRA0236..0243, replica RULE0312..0318 and independent BF0006..0009 cover scope discovery, targeted/full scan conditions, limitations, reporting and completion.

claims.actor: Assistant conducting the K1 security-scan workflow
claims.enforcement_effect: Required investigation when applicable, not an automatic vulnerability finding.
claims.confidence: HIGH source wording; MEDIUM-HIGH separate procedural norm
claims.claim: During a frontend dependency scan, review lockfiles when package integrity or unexpected dependency changes are relevant.
claims.trigger: Security-scan dependency layer for an existing frontend workspace where integrity or unexpected changes are relevant.
claims.exceptions: No automatic vulnerability declaration; relevance and actual workspace surface condition the review.

baseline_comparisons.reason: The npm investigation passage is dismissed as NON_NORMATIVE. Lockfile consistency/build guidance elsewhere does not require integrity/change investigation during a scan.
The production-versus-development audit prompt is NON_NORMATIVE; npm-ci/lockfile maintenance obligations have different triggers and purposes.

Its broad quote contains this sentence, but registered actions are source trust, direct/transitive context, npm audit, upgrade permission and fake-secret exceptions. No lockfile integrity/change review is separately represented.

claims.comparison_reason: An auditor can satisfy npm audit, feed trust and dependency context checks without inspecting the lockfile for integrity or unexplained changes. Broad quotation is not equivalent atomic registration.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: After an unexpected dependency change, run npm audit and assess reachable vulnerabilities but omit lockfile inspection: existing recorded actions can be satisfied while this conditional review is missed.

claims.claim: During applicable security configuration review, inspect production debug/development flags.
claims.trigger: Security-scan workflow inspecting an application's production configuration.
claims.exceptions: Review identifies evidence for adjudication; enabling a flag is not automatically declared a vulnerability.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Further review prompts are NON_NORMATIVE. Visible startup failure and secrets logged at Debug address different behavior from inspection of production debug/development mode flags.
Configuration prompts are dismissed; fail-secure startup and applicable scan scope do not separately name this inspection action.
Surface discovery and full-layer completion are general workflow requirements, not registration of the distinct production-mode inspection.

claims.comparison_reason: The source adds this investigation independently of credential disclosure, exception verbosity and insecure startup fallback. Prior general scan requirements do not atomize this action.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: A production debug mode is enabled while startup authentication remains secure and no secrets are logged. A scan reviewing those existing concerns still must inspect the mode flag.
